lessons.title: Practice Running Average Stream
lessons.description: Finish running_average. Yield the running average after each number in a sequence. The test checks that list(running_average([2, 4, 6])) equals [2.0, 3.0, 4.0].
learning_objectives: This step yields the running whole-number average, using averages and 38.
lessons.solution_code:
def running_average(nums):
    total = 0
    count = 0
    for x in nums:
        total += x
        count += 1
        yield total / count

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — The yield statement — incremental results from generators (Language Reference)
